summary.oneLiner: Wonder Electricals is scaling as India's leading listed fan OEM/ODM, leveraging BLDC growth and off-season appliance diversification to drive 100%+ revenue growth and margin expansion, while strategically expanding capacity via internal accruals. The company's operational discipline, vendor stickiness, and lack of listed peers create a durable competitive moat.

one-line thesis: Wonder Electricals is scaling as India's leading listed fan OEM/ODM, leveraging BLDC growth and off-season appliance diversification to drive 100%+ revenue growth and margin expansion, while strategically expanding capacity via internal accruals. The company's operational discipline, vendor stickiness, and lack of listed peers create a durable competitive moat.
financial scorecard: rev: +101% YoY; EBITDA: 2.68% margin; PAT: not disclosed; orderbook: fully booked in season; netdebt: minimal (funded via internal accruals + modest bank loans)
guidance: H1 FY25 revenue was INR361cr (+101% YoY); company aims to maintain similar growth for full FY25; no formal full-year guidance given but management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum.
order book & pipeline: Fully booked during peak season; idle capacity exists in off-season, partially offset by heaters/kettles production.
segment / subsidiary detail: BLDC fans: 2.35 lakh units in H1FY25 (up from 60k in H1FY24, +291.6%); total units sold: 32.95 lakh in H1FY25; heaters/kettles: new product line, first-year, no revenue share disclosed; TPW fans: growing segment; ventilating fans: core offering.
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into TPW (table, pedestal, wall) plastic fan manufacturing via new INR3cr plant (to commission early FY26); potential to scale heaters/kettles into a material segment over 2-3 years; possible export entry in future.
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin improved to 2.68% in H1FY25; BLDC fans have slightly better margins than induction fans; overall margin improvement driven by volume leverage, cost optimization, and product mix shift, not solely BLDC.
capex / expansion: INR3 crores allocated for new TPW manufacturing line; ongoing machinery upgrades; funded primarily by internal accruals with minor bank funding.
capital allocation: Primarily internal accruals for capex and working capital; modest bank term loans used; no dividends or buybacks mentioned; focus on reinvestment for capacity and product diversification.
risks & watch-items: High seasonality of fan demand; reliance on B2B customer relationships (no direct branding); potential margin pressure if BLDC growth slows; MSME payment compliance pressures on working capital; new product lines (heaters/kettles) unproven at scale.
management quality / tone: Confident, experienced, and pragmatic; emphasis on delivery reliability, quality, and operational efficiency; avoids overpromising on new products; highlights long-term vendor relationships and lack of listed competition as key advantages.
non-obvious takeaways: The company's 'stickiness' with customers is unusually high — nearly all customers have stayed for decades, with attrition only when customers started their own units; this suggests deep operational trust, not just price-based loyalty.

themes.title: Electronics manufacturing (EMS) & Make-in-India localization
themes.need: PLI + import-substitution + global China+1 sourcing drive an electronics-manufacturing build-out across consumer durables, defence and components. AMBER/PGEL/EPACK/SYRMA/AVALON/CYIENTDLM on box-build/EMS; DIXON-tier scale; CPPLUS/CNL on surveillance; KAYNES/SYRMA on integrated components; appliance ODMs (EPACK, AMBER) ride RAC/white-goods localization.
themes.driver: PLI disbursement + new ODM/OEM program wins; appliance season; defence/aero EMS conversion (AVALON, CYIENTDLM).

themes.title: Consumer durables, cooling & electricals
themes.need: Rising incomes, electrification and a record cooling season drive consumer-electricals and appliances - HAVELLS/VOLTAS/BLUESTARCO/SYMPHONY/ORIENTELEC on cooling & electricals; TTKPRESTIG/STOVEKRAFT/BAJAJELEC/EUREKAFORB on kitchen/home; CROMPTON-tier fans & pumps; premiumization + GST 2.0 + summer demand expand the organized share. Q1FY27's small-cap read: SONAMLTD grew revenue 75.6% YoY to INR 66.57cr on a cheap raw-material inventory position taken 6-7 months in advance while selling prices rose - management explicitly called the 75% print non-repeatable and guided FY27 to 25-30% with a Q2 floor of INR 40-50cr - and is pivoting from volume to INR 5,000-15,000 value clocks with capacity utilisation still only 60-70%.
themes.driver: Summer cooling demand; GST 2.0 price cuts; festive restocking; commodity-cost tailwind on margins; premiumization/ASP mix shift.
